description: Ishmael boards the Pequod to hunt Moby Dick. Melville mixes maritime adventure, whale science and meditation on obsession.

hero.hook: Call me Ishmael: three words that open one of the cathedrals of American literature.

blocks.text: Published in **1851**, **Moby Dick** is not just a story of maritime adventures. The full original title is *Moby-Dick; or, The Whale*. **Herman Melville**, born in **1819** and died in **1891**, mixes epic, treatise on cetaceans and metaphysical reflections. Misunderstood upon its release, this  monument has become a founding myth. [[American literature]]

The novel explores the titanic struggle between man, nature and the divine, through the hunt for a legendary white whale. Its incipit, “Call me Ishmael”, is one of the most famous openings in literature.

**Herman Melville** sailed on whaling ships in the Pacific in the years **1840**. He even lived among tribes of the [[Marquesas]], an archipelago of French Polynesia. With this experience, he wrote his opus between **1850** and **1851**, in a house shared with **Nathaniel Hawthorne**.

blocks.caption: Herman Melville, forgotten during his lifetime, rediscovered in the 20th century.

blocks.text: When he died in **1891**, Melville was so forgotten that the New York Times published an obituary in the name "Henry Melville."

The novel is a total commercial failure. Melville dies convinced that his name will disappear. It was only in the 20th century that it entered the [[Literary canon]], a set of works considered fundamental and worthy of being taught.

blocks.text: **Moby Dick** is a white ,  invincible. This biblical sea monster possesses colossal power. For **Ahab**, it is not an animal but the mask of the cosmic . Ahab sees this as deliberate wickedness projected onto the universe. Having lost his leg, he devotes his life to tracking down Evil incarnate. [[Sperm whale]] [[Leviathan]] [[Malignancy]]

blocks.caption: The Pequod facing the ocean: commercial voyage turned theological quest.

blocks.text: Melville uses  to emphasize the indifference of nature. It is a waxy substance called spermaceti, housed in the sperm whale's head. White represents a terrifying void, an unresponsiveness from the universe. Each character projects their own demons onto the whale. [[Whale white]]

sections.title: The white whale as a mirror of the absolute

blocks.text: During the final assault, Moby Dick pulverizes the Pequod. Ahab dies strangled by his harpoon rope. Only Ishmael survives, floating on Queequeg's coffin, picked up by the whaler **Rachael**. The entire crew disappears into the ocean.

Ishmael's survival allows the birth of the book. The survivor bears witness to the madness of men and the indomitable power of nature. If man cannot conquer the unknown, he can tell the story of it. Melville mixes maritime adventure, whale encyclopedia and meditation on destructive obsession. Entire chapters describe , the study of cetaceans, with almost scientific precision, before descending into tragedy. [[Cetology]]
**Moby Dick** transforms the hunt for a sperm whale into a philosophical odyssey about Ahab's obsession and the indifference of a universe of which Ishmael is the only witness.
